environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) in private subnet running identical Node.js 14.x monolith. Traffic routed through ALB with AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached. WebACL includes rule group reference statement with vendorName 'AWS' and name 'AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet' at priority 1 with overrideAction none (default BLOCK actions preserved). This managed rule set includes the JavaDeserializationRCE_BODY, JavaDeserializationRCE_QUERYSTRING, JavaDeserializationRCE_URI, Host_localhost_HEADER, PROPFIND_METHOD, and ExploitablePaths_URIPATH rules. Additionally, a custom rule with priority 0 uses a RegexPatternSet matching body content against pattern '(?i)(__proto__|constructor\s*\.\s*prototype|\[\s*["\x27]__proto__["\x27]\s*\])' with action BLOCK and textTransformation of URL_DECODE followed by LOWERCASE on the request body field with OversizeHandling MATCH. CloudWatch metrics enabled with sampled requests.

config.security_group: allow TCP/443 from ALB SG only
